performance.verdict: CPL crisis is real; 5 overdue SOW milestones risk the August renewal scoreboard.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: 2026-07-23 renewal close); dashboard, scoreboard trust, and attribution gap all unresolved — client's stay/walk decision is past due.
CPL spiked 46.68% in 7 days on near-flat spend (-3.74%); 3-day leads (Sep 6–8: 6+2+4=12) vs prior 3 (Sep 3–5: 4+2+0=6) show a mild rebound but still below Aug peak of 8/day.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for 8 straight days (Sep 1–8), a 100% collapse from a prior 45-day average of ~8/day — organic top-of-funnel is dark.
Retargeting campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting' holds $405.97 of $789.05 (28-day spend, 51%); flat-to-falling leads with stable spend signals audience exhaustion in a small retargeting pool.
GHL returned a 500 internal server error this run — pipeline lead counts unverifiable; any intake-vs-ads comparison is blind until resolved.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer/Sohib; dashboard and attribution gap are renewal blockers as of 2026-08-31.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are past due, the oldest from 2026-07-23 (renewal close); the dashboard and August scoreboard trust items expired 2026-08-31. suggestions.text: Introduce at least 1 new prospecting creative to reduce reliance on retargeting pool absorbing 51% of 28-day spend ($405.97).
